maddeler.e:
اندثرت (form VII)
# اِنْدَثَرْتُ (indaṯartu) /in.da.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
# اِنْدَثَرْتَ (indaṯarta) /in.da.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
# اِنْدَثَرْتِ (indaṯarti) /in.da.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
# اِنْدَثَرَتْ (indaṯarat) /in.da.θa.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
